caption: The drawing depicts a single, symmetrical vessel resembling a rounded ceramic jar with two curved handles, one on each side near the top. The jar has a short, slightly flared neck with a relatively narrow mouth and a smoothly rounded, broad body that tapers downward. The handles are attached just below the rim and arc outward before rejoining the body. The vessel is uniformly colored in shades of light to medium brown, with subtle gradients indicating light and shadow on the curved surface, giving it a three-dimensional appearance. The background is off-white with a thin rectangular border sketched around the vessel, and the artist’s signature, "Annie B. Johnston," appears in the lower right corner outside the border. There are no other objects or additional decorative elements in the image.
title: Stoneware Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
